items.title: George Wein — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My brother went to several colleges.

ctx.x: Ah! Okay. Now, your brother went off to college, went to New York to NYU, I believe?

My brother went to several colleges. (chuckles) He didn't last too long at any of them because he didn't want it … he knew he was going in the Army and so he didn't care. But he did spend a few months at NYU.
